sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: VAZ car key (Shestyorka) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the VAZ cars commonly known as Shestyorka ("the sixth one").

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This key does not currently open any lock.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- VAZ, now AvtoVAZ is a automobile manufacturer. The company is best known for its flagship series of Lada vehicles
- Sixpack is probably a bad translation of SHESTERKA, meaning LADA-2106 or VAZ model 6 (thus six-rka). A Word created similar to tushonka (stewed-nka) or ushanka (ears-nka meaning a hat with ears)
